fusions.name: Gossamer Lash
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 7 damage, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. Anything struck moves 25% slower for 3s. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Snarl
fusions.desc: A lash that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Cover
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sipped Thread
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
